verdict_basis: All 10 targets are anchored to SU-C-21/MCC 14, have unique semantic fingerprints, test materially different educational decisions, and pass the complete 45-pair duplicate audit. Evidence-pending targets remain blocked from generation until their exact gaps and proposed edges are researched and validated.

evidence_gaps.exact_gap: Right-ventricular infarction hemodynamic pattern, cautious crystalloid preload support, nitrate avoidance, and exact discriminators against diuresis or beta-blocker escalation.

Recognition of acute-MI cardiogenic shock, emergency revascularization priority with concurrent shock support, and exact discriminators against vasoactive-only, fluids-only, or delayed-angiography strategies.

Current Canadian-applicable initial aspirin and parenteral-anticoagulation strategy for confirmed NSTE-ACS, relevant bleeding exceptions, and exact discriminators against fibrinolysis or single-component therapy.
Exact absolute fibrinolysis contraindication to instantiate and the primary-PCI transfer pathway when fibrinolysis is prohibited, including no-reperfusion and lysis-anyway discriminators.
Timing and diagnostic pattern of papillary muscle rupture with acute severe mitral regurgitation and exact discriminators from septal rupture, free-wall rupture/tamponade, and recurrent ischemia.

Definitive management and urgency of post-MI ventricular septal rupture with shock, the role of temporary stabilization, and exact discriminators against medical-only, PCI-only, or elective repair pathways.

Current Canadian-applicable high-risk NSTE-ACS features requiring inpatient early invasive evaluation and exact discriminators against discharge, outpatient stress testing, or observation without an invasive plan.

pairwise_semantic_duplicate_audit.duplicate_rule: FAIL when two targets test the same operative learner decision and differ only by demographics, incidental setting, wording, or a non-decisive vignette fact. Shared disease family or workflow adjacency is not duplication when the governing discriminator, reasoning path, and intended key materially change.
